question: Unsa ang mga plano, pirma sa inhinyero ug clearances nga kailangan i-submit para makakuha ug building permit sa OCBO?
answer: Ang mga plano, pirma sa inhinyero, at clearances na kailangan i-submit para makakuha ug building permit sa OCBO ay nakalistahan sa mga chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0009-C001, DEV120-OCBO-PDF0033-C001, at DEV120-OCBO-PDF0048-C002 sa CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf. [S1], [S2], at [S4] ang mga chunk na nakalagay sa mga pagkakataon na ito.

ground_truth: To secure a Building Permit under PD 1096, applicants must submit: 1) Notarized Application Letter; 2) Accomplished Unified Building Permit Form (5 copies); 3) Complete sets of Architectural, Civil/Structural, Sanitary/Plumbing, Electrical, and Mechanical Permit forms and plans (5 sets each), all duly signed and sealed by licensed professionals (Architect, Civil Engineer, Sanitary Engineer/Master Plumber, Professional Electrical Engineer, Professional Mechanical Engineer); 4) Certified true copies of Land Title (LRA), Tax Declaration, and Current Real Property Tax Receipt; 5) CPDO Zoning Locational Clearance; and 6) BFP Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC).
